summary: Iter95 — Weather forecast feature (Open-Meteo, Fahrenheit) end-to-end verified. Backend: 11/11 pytest checks pass — auth-gated /api/weather returns correct reason branches (no_location, past, out_of_range, bad_date), positive path works for seeded cities (Dallas, TX / Round Rock, TX / Orlando, FL and full addresses containing them) returning available=true with high_f/low_f/condition/emoji/precip_pct, and /api/calendar competition + schedule items now expose 'location' and 'weather_date' fields. Frontend: (1) Competition detail 'Weather Demo Comp' renders testID=comp-weather with '☀️ 73° / 53°F · Clear sky · 💧 80%' (full chip). (2) Schedule tab renders the compact weather chip (emoji present in DOM) for events with location + upcoming date. (3) Calendar Day view for today+3 shows the 'Weather Demo Comp / Dallas, TX' row with a compact '☀️ 73°' weather badge under the subtitle. Deprecated packages detected: none new. No React Native red screens or new component issues introduced by this feature.

ui_bugs.issue: Cosmetic: unit label 'F' is only appended to the LOW temp, not the HIGH — renders as '73° / 53°F'. Reads a bit inconsistent; recommend either '73° / 53°' (no F) or '73°F / 53°F'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/WeatherBadge.tsx:89 — `<Text style={styles.temp}>{hi}<Text style={styles.tempLow}> / {lo}F</Text></Text>`.

action_items: (Optional / cosmetic) Fix the °F unit rendering in WeatherBadge.tsx line 89 so both high and low temps show the same unit suffix, e.g., `{hi} / {lo}F` or drop 'F' since Fahrenheit is implied.
No functional fixes required — feature ships as spec'd.

In production (no rate-limit), the seeded synthetic forecast cache used for Dallas/Round Rock/Orlando should be short-lived; ensure the normal Open-Meteo path works when the shared preview egress IP is no longer throttled.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/weather.py: geocode candidate builder correctly strips ZIPs and prefers city-before-state, allowing 'Kalahari Resort, Round Rock, TX 78665' to resolve. Good.
routers/weather.py: forecast cache TTL is only 1h and negative cache is skipped on HTTP 429 — correctly avoids poisoning cache with 'unavailable'. Good.

routers/calendar.py: 'location' and 'weather_date' are added to both competition rows (weather_date=ev, the first day of the comp) and schedule rows (weather_date=ds, i.e. per-day span). This is correct — the calendar-row weather forecast should reflect the actual day of that row, not the series start.
WeatherBadge.tsx: uses in-memory cache keyed by location|date and short-circuits on empty location/date — hidden gracefully. Good.
WeatherBadge.tsx: compact variant returns null on loading which is the right choice to avoid layout jitter in lists.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing 'Weather Demo Comp' seeded by main agent (Dallas, TX, today+3) and the preview synthetic weather cache for Dallas/Round Rock/Orlando.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Weather feature shipped and verified. Open-Meteo forecast API is rate-limited from the preview egress IP (HTTP 429) — main agent seeded synthetic forecast cache for exactly 'Dallas, TX', 'Round Rock, TX', 'Orlando, FL' (addresses containing these cities also resolve). Positive weather assertions must use one of these three cities. Any other city correctly returns available=false, reason='unavailable' in preview — that's expected, not a bug. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter95_weather.py can be re-run any time as a regression suite.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug filed. The only nit is the cosmetic 'F' suffix placement in the full chip (LOW priority).
